data.one_liner: An aid tool for hackathon judges, likely helps evaluate and score hackathon submissions, for event organizers and judges.
data.description: Hackathon Judge Aid appears to be a web application designed to assist judges at hackathon events with evaluating and scoring participant submissions. The app name strongly implies structured judging workflows, rubric management, or scoring aggregation. No live content could be retrieved to confirm specific features.
data.target_user: Hackathon organizer or assigned judge who needs to evaluate and score multiple team submissions

icp.who: Hackathon organizers and volunteer judges at tech events, universities, or corporate innovation programs
icp.pain: Coordinating scores from multiple judges across many teams using spreadsheets is error-prone, slow, and hard to aggregate fairly
icp.buying_trigger: Organizing an upcoming hackathon and needing a structured, shareable way to collect and tally judge scores
